data.name: Nawaab
data.gender_notes: Nawaab is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is the master or lord of a group or household. The name Nawaab carries the meaning “Lord, Master” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Urdu, Arabic. Parents who choose Nawaab usually hope their child will grow to embody lord, master and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Nawaab belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord, Master.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Nawaab total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_arabic.name: نواب
in_arabic.meaning: نواب اسم معنی حاکم، فرمانروا، امیر، وزیر یا گورنر
in_arabic.long_meaning: نواب از ریشه عربی 'ن و ب' مشتق شده است که به معنی حاکم، فرمانروا، امیر، وزیر یا گورنر می باشد. این کلمه در زبان عربی به کار رفته و در فرهنگ اسلامی به عنوان یک لقب برای حاکمان و امیران استفاده می شود. نواب همچنین می تواند به معنی شخصیت های مهم و با نفوذ در جامعه اسلامی باشد.

in_urdu.name: نواب
in_urdu.meaning: نواب کا مطلب ہوتا ہے حاکم، امیر، وزیر یا گورنر
in_urdu.long_meaning: نواب عربی زبان کی اصطلاح ہے جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے حاکم، امیر، وزیر یا گورنر۔ یہ لفظ عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے اور اسلامی ثقافت میں حکمرانوں اور امیروں کے لئے ایک لقب کے طور پر استعمال ہوتا ہے۔ اردو میں، نواب کا استعمال اکثر اعلیٰ طبقے کے افراد یا اہم شخصیات کے لئے کیا جاتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: नवाब
in_hindi.meaning: नवाब का अर्थ होता है शासक, गवर्नर, या उच्च पदस्थ व्यक्ति
in_hindi.long_meaning: नवाब शब्द अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ होता है शासक, गवर्नर, या उच्च पदस्थ व्यक्ति। यह शब्द इस्लामी संस्कृति में शासकों और उच्च पदस्थ अधिकारियों के लिए एक उपाधि के रूप में प्रयोग किया जाता है। भारतीय उपमहाद्वीप में, नवाब का प्रयोग अक्सर मुस्लिम शासकों और रईसों के लिए किया जाता था।

in_pashto.name: نواب
in_pashto.meaning: نواب دى معنى دى حاکم، امیر، وزیر یا ګورنر
in_pashto.long_meaning: نواب د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې دى معنى دى حاکم، امیر، وزیر یا ګورنر. دا کلمه د اسلامي کلتور کې د واکمنانو او امیرو په توګه کارول کیږي. په افغانستان کې، نواب اکثره د لوړو پوړو کسانو یا مهمو شخصیتونو لپاره کارول کیږي.

in_english.name: Nawaab
in_english.meaning: Nawaab means governor, ruler, noble, or high-ranking official
in_english.long_meaning: The name Nawaab originates from Arabic roots 'n-w-b', meaning 'to announce' or 'to delegate'. In Islamic tradition, Nawaab refers to a high-ranking official, governor, or noble. Historically, the term was used for rulers and administrators in various Muslim dynasties. The name signifies authority, leadership, and nobility, reflecting positive personality traits such as governance, diplomacy, and social responsibility.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Nawaab" has its origins in Urdu and Persian languages, commonly used in the Indian subcontinent's Islamic community. The title has a strong cultural significance, emphasizing the importance of leadership and the care and provision for those under one's authority. A "Nawaab" represents power, status, wealth, and the ability to govern and protect his community. In historical contexts, this title was often used for both secular and spiritual rulers, including Mughal emperors. Therefore, the name "Nawaab" evokes feelings of nobility, power, and responsibility.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the Islamic name "Nawaab" can be found in its connection to leadership and stewardship in the Islamic tradition. Each Muslim is seen as a vicegerent, or "Khalifah," of God on earth, responsible for applying Allah's guidance in their daily lives and interacting with others. As a "Nawaab," one is understandably entrusted with this responsibility on a larger scale, reflecting the importance of strong and compassionate leadership within Muslim communities. Additionally, the Arabic root of "Nawaab," "nawaba," translates to "rest" or "take a rest," reflecting the notion that a leader should provide for his people and ensure their comfort, contributing to a safer, stronger community. Thus, the title "Nawaab" underscores the spiritual obligation for powerful, responsible, and compassionate leadership.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Lord, Master" symbolizes One who is the master or lord of a group or household. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Nawaab serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of lord, master.
